subject.title: fix(feishu): disable ambient proxy inheritance for WebSocket by default

question: Should Feishu WebSocket egress default to direct connections with `OPENCLAW_FEISHU_WS_USE_PROXY=1` as the opt-in, or should ambient proxy inheritance remain the upgrade default?
rationale: The source change is small, but it changes an existing proxy/security default for Feishu inbound delivery and cannot be accepted safely by code review alone.

options.title: Close stale PR and require a fresh proven proposal
options.body: Close this branch now and ask for a rebased or fresh PR with real transport proof, docs, cleanup, and explicit policy approval.

options.title: Sponsor direct-by-default Feishu WS
options.body: A maintainer can reopen or sponsor the same policy direction after current-head proof and upgrade documentation are added.

options.title: Preserve ambient proxy by default
options.body: Keep existing proxy inheritance and pursue an explicit direct/bypass mode or broader per-channel proxy policy instead.

recommendation.title: Close stale PR and require a fresh proven proposal
recommendation.body: Close this branch now and ask for a rebased or fresh PR with real transport proof, docs, cleanup, and explicit policy approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR discussion explicitly asked this handle to confirm the egress-policy default, and the shared proxy helper history is relevant to the decision.
